falsifiers_attempted.claim: D1: Pages configuration uses separate pages_configure authorization (not git_content_publish)
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does execute_publication() consume pages_configure authorization for Pages mutation and git_content_publish for content?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: _authorize_content_publication() → git_content_publish, _authorize_pages_configuration() → pages_configure. Content auth consumed at line 262, Pages auth at line 401. Capability contracts: Contents:write for content, Pages:write+Administration:write for Pages.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: D2: Tree preserves branch contents via resolved base_tree SHA
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does _publish_atomic() resolve current branch commit tree SHA and pass as base_tree?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: get_base_ref() resolves current_sha → get_commit_tree(current_sha) resolves base_tree_sha → create_tree(tree_entries, base_tree=base_tree_sha). Falls through gracefully when branch doesn't exist.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: D3: published_files set only after ref update succeeds; orphaned_commit_sha for failed ref
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does _publish_atomic() distinguish blobs_created from published_files? Is published_files set only after update_ref succeeds?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: ContentPublicationManifest has distinct fields: blobs_created (blob-by-blob), tree_created, commit_created, ref_updated, published_files (only after ref success), orphaned_commit_sha (on ref failure). published_files set only at line 1034-1035.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: D4: Content published before Pages configured
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Is content publication executed before Pages mutation? Is Pages configuration gated on content_published?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: execute_publication() publishes content at lines 289-358, then reads Pages at 361, then configures Pages at 388 with gate 'if needs_pages_mutation and content_published'. Pages never configured without successful content publication.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: D5: X0 contract uses projection_digest and terminal_receipt_digest
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does build_status_contract() return projection_digest (not evidence_digest) and terminal_receipt_digest?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: PublicationStatusContract has projection_digest (partial status) and terminal_receipt_digest (links to durable receipt.evidence_digest). Old evidence_digest field removed.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: D6: Review cycle record in committed path
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Is the review cycle record committed in docs/json/evidence/ rather than .build/?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Record is at docs/json/evidence/prepublication_review_cycle_x3_5.v1.json and will be in the pushed commit. No .build/-only record.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: No authorization bypass: Pages mutation has correct permission
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Can Pages be configured under only a Contents:write authorization? Is pages_configure authorization required?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Lines 388-415: Pages mutation requires a separate pages_authorization_receipt_id. If missing, returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED with truthful state (content_published=True, Pages not configured). Pages_auth consumed via _authorize_pages_configuration which maps to pages_configure → GITHUB_PAGES_CONFIGURE → Pages:write+Administration:write.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does the code have unused variable content_receipt?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Grep for content_receipt across publication/ returns zero hits. X3.4's unused variable excised.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Do deployment_event and deployment_evidence schemas include the new phase?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Both schemas updated with 'content_commit_created_ref_not_updated' in transition_phase enum. Phase enum model updated.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Do all tests pass? pyright? ruff?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: 131 tests pass, 0 pyright errors, ruff clean. One pre-existing PLR0904 in _real_github_boundary suppressed with per-file-ignore.

findings.violated_claim: Publication to empty branch works seamlessly
findings.evidence: _publish_atomic() uses update_ref(force=False) which requires the branch ref to pre-exist. If gh-pages doesn't exist, ref update will fail. Recovery is truthful (orphaned_commit_sha, CONTENT_COMMIT_CREATED_REF_NOT_UPDATED). Sequential fallback creates branch implicitly via put_file_contents.
findings.required_repair: Future slice: add create_branch_ref guard before ref update when branch doesn't exist.
